record.question: One or more Excise and Narcotics Constables will be placed on duty in courts when Excise and Narcotics cases are being tried, and in all other criminal courts when available. Their duties are (i) to guard prisoners in the Court premises. (ii) to look after exhibits produced before the Court. (iii) to keep order in the Court. (iv) to assist the Court Officer in any way that he may direct.
